user.title: Connect Antigravity
user.description: A login flow started from Home Assistant does not work for Antigravity (Google redirects back to the machine that started the login). Paste a refresh token from a program that signed in as Antigravity instead: the Antigravity CLI (`~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/antigravity-oauth-token`, value under `token` → `refresh_token`) or tuxevil-rotator (`~/.tuxevil-rotator/accounts.json`). Gemini CLI tokens do not work. An access token is fetched automatically.

data.project_id: Google Cloud project ID (optional, usually leave blank)

error.invalid_token: Google rejected the refresh token. Copy it again — it must come from Antigravity, not Gemini CLI.
error.cannot_connect: Google cannot be reached right now.

abort.cannot_connect: Google cannot be reached right now.
abort.already_configured: This Antigravity account is already connected.
